dimensions.assessment: Affects diplomatic and agency personnel in the Departments of State and Energy, as well as broader international relations with Eastern Mediterranean and IMEC countries.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of State may institutionalize multilateral strategic dialogues between the United States and IMEC countries

dimensions.assessment: Establishes policy guidelines, reporting mandates, and diplomatic prioritization without directly altering domestic laws or creating spending appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of State shall prioritize the Eastern Mediterranean region in United States foreign policy

dimensions.assessment: Requires studies and reports on program creation and feasibility but does not allocate specific spending amounts.

dimensions.assessment: Directs executive branch foreign policy priorities, strategic dialogues, and reporting requirements involving multiple federal departments.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of State, in coordination with the Secretary of Homeland Security, shall analyze insights gained from the operation of the Cyprus Centre

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing reporting schedules extending over multiple years alongside permanent foreign policy statements.
